title: Align SDK credential presets, streaming consumer ergonomics, and minor API parity fixes (py/ts/go) — bump versions
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Aligned credential preset APIs across Python/TypeScript/Go, improved streaming consumer ergonomics (resume/peek semantics), clarified retry preset defaults and bumped SDK versions: py 1.12.0, ts 1.8.3, go v1.5.0. Non-breaking; migration notes included.
description:
Context: multiple consumer teams reported small inconsistencies between SDKs when migrating long-lived streaming integrations and when swapping credential sources. This PR harmonizes a small set of primitives: CredentialPreset (name + policy), default retry presets, and streaming consumer UX for pause/resume/peek. It also addresses a subtle token-rotation race in the Go connector discovered during dedicated capacity tests.

What this PR does (high level):
- Introduces CredentialPreset objects across Py/TS/Go with identical public fields and a stable serialization shape for config injection.
- Exposes a lightweight "preset" selection on client constructors (e.g. Client(preset="low-latency")).
- Normalizes retry preset names (fast, balanced, conservative) and aligns default backoff windows and jitter.
- Unifies streaming consumer primitives: async iterator resume(), peek(n) helper, and explicit close/abort semantics.
- Fixes token rotation race in Go connector when multiple goroutines refresh the same session token; added a central in-process lease map.
- Small ergonomics follow-ups: improved error types, more helpful docstrings, and parity test additions across SDKs.

Checklist: [x] API design doc (ENG-1128) referenced [x] Tests added across SDKs [x] Changelog entries [x] Version bump commits [x] CI green (flaky test retried once)

Risks / migration notes: all changes are additive or backwards-compatible; retry preset renames include mapping table for older names. Streaming consumer changes preserve previous semantics but add optional helpers—no forced migration.

Full change summary below and short notes for release engineering.
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial credential-preset cross-SDK definitions; py/ts/go client constructors accept 'preset' param; retry preset normalization & mapping; streaming consumer API additions and tests; Go token lease implementation and unit tests; docs + changelogs; version bumps and release artifacts.
discussion_thread_summary: Reviewer feedback focused on naming consistency and tests covering token rotation under concurrency. Kenji requested a small refactor to the Go lease map for clearer invariants; addressed in commit 5 with additional unit tests. Marta asked for clearer migration notes for retry preset name mapping; added docs/migration/presets.md and two examples. Ethan asked to ensure the new 'preset' constructor param is validated server-side in case of typos; added validation and mapping fallback. Final approvals after one CI rerun.
review_comments: Kenji Watanabe: Found a potential deadlock if lease_map lock is held while doing network calls. Suggest split responsibilities — keep the lock scoped and double-check refresh logic.
Priya Nair (author): Good catch — refactored lease_map to use compare-and-swap path with per-key mutexes; added unit test 'TestConcurrentRefresh' to reproduce and guard against the deadlock.
Marta Alvarez: Please add migration example mapping old retry names ("legacy-fast") to the new 'fast' preset and show how to set it via env var.
Priya Nair (author): Added docs/migration/presets.md and included examples for env var and constructor preset mapping.
Ethan Brooks: Minor: TS client index exported type names differ from Python naming (CredentialPreset vs credential_preset). Can we keep PascalCase across TS/Go and snake_case in Python?
Priya Nair (author): We agreed to keep idiomatic naming per language: PascalCase for TS/Go, snake_case for Python; added explicit note in the design doc and samples in each SDK's README.
post_merge_notes: Release engineering: builds produced artifacts for each SDK. Python wheel uploaded to internal index under 1.12.0; TS package pushed to npm under 1.8.3-canary then promoted; Go tags pushed v1.5.0. Kept compat shim for old retry names for two minor releases. Monitor token-rotation metrics for 48h after deploy.
testing_notes: Added cross-SDK stream parity job (sdk-compat-tests/stream-parity.yml) that runs isolated consumer/resume scenarios across py/ts/go. Go added TestConcurrentRefresh and TestLeaseMapStability; python added TestStreamResumeIdempotence; ts added stream-resume.spec.ts. All tests run in CI matrix.
notes_for_changelog: SDKs: credential preset API, streaming consumer helpers (resume/peek), retry preset normalization, token-rotation race fix in Go, minor docs and version bumps. Migration steps in docs/sdks/migration/presets.md.
